const body = $input.first().json.body;
const bad = () => [{ json: { valid: false } }];
if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) return bad();
const text = (key, max) => typeof body[key] === 'string' && body[key].trim().length <= max ? body[key].trim() : null;
const lead = {};
for (const [key, max] of Object.entries({name:100, company:150, email:254, whatsapp:30, service:100, industry:100, budget:100, details:3000})) {
  lead[key] = text(key, max);
  if (lead[key] === null) return bad();
}
if (lead.name.length < 2 || !lead.company || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(lead.email) || lead.details.length < 15 || body.source !== 'apsal-portfolio') return bad();
if (lead.whatsapp && !/^[+()\d\s-]{7,30}$/.test(lead.whatsapp)) return bad();
const services = ["Digital Marketing & Lead Generation", "AI Workflow Automation", "AI Voice Assistant", "AI Agents & Customer Support", "Website Development", "CRM Automation", "Not Sure Yet"];
const industries = ["Real Estate", "Clinics & Healthcare", "E-commerce & D2C", "Service Business / SME", "Other"];
const budgets = ["Prefer to discuss", "Below ₹25,000", "₹25,000–₹50,000", "₹50,000–₹1,00,000", "Above ₹1,00,000"];
if (!services.includes(lead.service) || !industries.includes(lead.industry) || !budgets.includes(lead.budget)) return bad();
// Treat untrusted enquiry fields as spreadsheet text, never formulas.
const safe = value => value; // Sheet writes use RAW to preserve text, not formulas.
if (body.submissionId !== undefined && (typeof body.submissionId !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(body.submissionId))) return bad();
const row = {
  "Submission ID": body.submissionId || "legacy-" + String($execution.id),
  "Received At": new Date().toISOString(),
  "Name": safe(lead.name), "Company": safe(lead.company),
  "Email": safe(lead.email), "WhatsApp": safe(lead.whatsapp),
  "Service": safe(lead.service), "Industry": safe(lead.industry),
  "Budget": safe(lead.budget), "Project Details": safe(lead.details),
  "Source": "apsal-portfolio", "Lead Status": "New", "Notification Status": "Pending", "Notified At": ""
};
const notification = ["New portfolio enquiry", "", "Name: " + lead.name, "Business: " + lead.company,
  "Email: " + lead.email, "WhatsApp: " + (lead.whatsapp || "Not provided"),
  "Service: " + lead.service, "Industry: " + lead.industry, "Budget: " + lead.budget,
  "", "Project details:", lead.details, "", "Saved to Portfolio Enquiries / Leads.",
  "Enquiry ID: " + row["Submission ID"]].join("\n");
return [{ json: { valid: true, row, notification } }];
